title: getEngagementPendingUpdate request
description: GET /v1/engagements/{engagementId}/pending-update - request. Offer state of one engagement (no summary content; S7 composes it with the summary).
$comment: Source: DISENO S3 (e), AP-I1 (GetItem ENG#id); PRD RF-035, RF-015. Audience: INTERNAL service-to-service - SX-01a family (S7 EngagementIndexClient). Residency: REGIONAL (cell of the firm); ENGAGEMENT_REGIONAL data never leaves the cell (RF-092, RF-093). Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (single resource).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
